verdict.rationale: Inngest documents function invocations as durable steps, and child runs triggered by invoke inherit parent context, so child workflows are a first-party capability with memoized, independently retried steps and no hand-rolled coordination. The pack never documents parallel step execution or fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches, which are two of the story's three parts. Missing for 10: documented parallel steps, fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches with result aggregation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a backend developer, I compose workflows from parallel steps, fan-out/fan-in over dynamic batches, and child workflows without hand-rolling coordination

citations.quote: Put side effects, API calls, sleeps, waits, and function invocations in steps so Inngest can memoize results, retry failures independently
Any run triggered by another run (via event, invoke, or defer) inherits its parent's sessions.
A sub-agent can be modeled as a separate Inngest function that runs its own agent loop
Inngest handles execution durability, state persistence, retries, and flow control for you.
